scenarios.title: A｜第一次联系
scenarios.setting: 玩家刚通过共同朋友认识了 Jamie，并拿到了对方的联系方式。

turns.prompt: 你想首次发消息时说明自己是谁、在哪里认识，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hey Jamie! This is Alex—we met at Sam’s party yesterday.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hey Jamie! This is Alex—we met at Sam’s party yesterday.
feedback.explanation: “this is Alex”电话中常用“This is + 姓名”自报身份。

choices.text: Hi Jamie, it’s Alex. Sam gave me your number. Hope that’s okay!

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi Jamie, it’s Alex. Sam gave me your number. Hope that’s okay!
feedback.explanation: 用简短回应表示不介意或愿意体谅，可以减轻对方的歉意。

choices.text: Hey! This is Alex from yesterday. It was nice meeting you.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hey! This is Alex from yesterday. It was nice meeting you.
feedback.explanation: 初次见面时表达友好，配合姓名或简短自我介绍就能开启交流。

choices.text: Hi, not sure if you remember me, but we met at Sam’s party last night.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, not sure if you remember me, but we met at Sam’s party last night.
feedback.explanation: 明确表达不确定，让对方知道需要进一步确认，而不是把猜测当作事实。

choices.text: Hello Jamie, I am Alex who met you yesterday.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Hey Jamie! This is Alex—we met at Sam’s party yesterday.
feedback.explanation: 聊天自报身份可说“It’s Alex—we met yesterday”；关系从句“I am Alex who …”显得刻意。

turns.text: Hey! Of course I remember you :) Nice meeting you too!

turns.prompt: 你想在首次联系得到回应后自然开始寒暄，会怎么说？

choices.text: Glad I found the right person haha. How’s your day going?

feedback.naturalExpression: Glad I found the right person haha. How’s your day going?
feedback.explanation: “how’s”用于询问某人的近况或某件事的进展，具体对象紧接其后。

choices.text: Haha good! I wasn’t sure if you’d remember me.

feedback.naturalExpression: Haha good! I wasn’t sure if you’d remember me.
feedback.explanation: 加上条件说明请求或安排的适用范围，让对方可以结合实际限制回应。

choices.text: Nice! I had a really good time yesterday.

feedback.naturalExpression: Nice! I had a really good time yesterday.
feedback.explanation: 提供自己经历或做过的具体情况，让对方能在已知信息上继续确认。

choices.text: By the way, you mentioned that café downtown. What was it called again?

feedback.naturalExpression: By the way, you mentioned that café downtown. What was it called again?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

turns.text: Oh yeah! It’s called North Street Coffee.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: That’s the one! Thanks :)

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s the one! Thanks :)
feedback.explanation: “the one”指代前面已谈到的人或物；补充位置或特征，就能区分具体是哪一个。

choices.text: Ah yes, that’s it. I’ll have to check it out sometime.

feedback.naturalExpression: Ah yes, that’s it. I’ll have to check it out sometime.
feedback.explanation: “have to”表示有必要或受条件限制必须这样做，可用于核实办理要求。

scenarios.title: B｜给朋友发消息
scenarios.setting: 玩家下午突然想问朋友晚上有没有安排。

turns.prompt: 你想发消息问问朋友今晚的安排，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hey, what are you up to tonight?

feedback.naturalExpression: Hey, what are you up to tonight?
feedback.explanation: “up to”谈限额时表示最多达到某个数量，适合确认包含的额度。

choices.text: Hey! You doing anything later?

feedback.naturalExpression: Hey! You doing anything later?
feedback.explanation: “You doing anything later?”省略了“Are”，熟人聊天中很常见，用来试探是否有空。

choices.text: Are you free this evening?

feedback.naturalExpression: Are you free this evening?
feedback.explanation: 先确认对方是否方便，再进入正题，适合需要占用对方时间时开场。

choices.text: Random question—want to grab dinner later?

feedback.naturalExpression: Random question—want to grab dinner later?
feedback.explanation: 用简短问句核对刚听到的信息，省略的部分由前面的对话补足，适合当面确认细节。

choices.text: What will you do tonight?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Hey, what are you up to tonight?
feedback.explanation: 这句语法正确；问今晚有什么安排，口语常用“What are you up to tonight?”。

turns.prompt: 关于「开始聊天」，你想提出一个接下来的做法或安排，会怎么建议？

choices.text: I was thinking we could grab something to eat.

feedback.naturalExpression: I was thinking we could grab something to eat.
feedback.explanation: “I was thinking”把想法作为尚在考虑的建议提出，方便一起讨论。

choices.text: Wanna get dinner somewhere?

feedback.naturalExpression: Wanna get dinner somewhere?
feedback.explanation: “Wanna”是“want to”的非正式口语写法，适合朋友间轻松约饭。

choices.text: I feel like going out for food. You in?

feedback.naturalExpression: I feel like going out for food. You in?
feedback.explanation: “feel like”表示想做某事，“You in?”简短询问对方是否一起，整体很口语化。

choices.text: There’s a new Korean place I want to try.

feedback.naturalExpression: There’s a new Korean place I want to try.
feedback.explanation: 用“there be”说明存在的事物或情况，先呈现事实，便于对方继续处理。

turns.prompt: 你想提出见面的时间，确认对方是否方便，会怎么说？

choices.text: Maybe around seven?

feedback.naturalExpression: Maybe around seven?
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

choices.text: Does 7 work for you?

feedback.naturalExpression: Does 7 work for you?
feedback.explanation: 围绕一个具体动作或情况提问，让对方针对这一步确认或解释。

choices.text: I’m flexible. Anytime after 6:30 works for me.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m flexible. Anytime after 6:30 works for me.
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

scenarios.title: C｜给同事发消息
scenarios.setting: 玩家通过工作聊天软件第一次私聊同事。

turns.prompt: 你想先确认同事是否方便，再提出工作上的询问，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hi Mia, do you have a minute? I have a quick question about the report.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi Mia, do you have a minute? I have a quick question about the report.
feedback.explanation: 先确认对方是否方便，再进入正题，适合需要占用对方时间时开场。

choices.text: Hey Mia, quick question when you have a second.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hey Mia, quick question when you have a second.
feedback.explanation: “quick question”提示只问件小事，“when you have a second”让对方方便时再答。

choices.text: Hi! Sorry to bother you—could I ask you something about tomorrow’s meeting?

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi! Sorry to bother you—could I ask you something about tomorrow’s meeting?
feedback.explanation: “Could I / we …?”礼貌提出自己的需求或征求许可；这里不是在说过去的能力。

choices.text: Hey, when you get a chance, could you take a look at something for me?

feedback.naturalExpression: Hey, when you get a chance, could you take a look at something for me?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Hi Mia, I want to ask you one question.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Hi Mia, do you have a minute? I have a quick question about the report.
feedback.explanation: 这句能提出问题，但稍显郑重；工作消息常用“quick question”简短引入。

turns.prompt: 你想核对接下来要使用的报告版本，会怎么说？

choices.text: Do you know which version of the report we’re using tomorrow?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you know which version of the report we’re using tomorrow?
feedback.explanation: “version”指版本，说明具体版本能避免双方使用不同文件。

choices.text: I just wanted to check whether we’re using the updated version.

feedback.naturalExpression: I just wanted to check whether we’re using the updated version.
feedback.explanation: “version”指版本，说明具体版本能避免双方使用不同文件。

choices.text: I have two versions here and I’m not sure which one’s final.

feedback.naturalExpression: I have two versions here and I’m not sure which one’s final.
feedback.explanation: 明确表达不确定，让对方知道需要进一步确认，而不是把猜测当作事实。

turns.text: The one I sent this morning is the final version.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Got it, thanks!

feedback.naturalExpression: Got it, thanks!
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: Perfect, that’s the one I have. Thanks.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect, that’s the one I have. Thanks.
feedback.explanation: “the one”指代前面已谈到的人或物；补充位置或特征，就能区分具体是哪一个。

choices.text: Great, just wanted to make sure.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great, just wanted to make sure.
feedback.explanation: “make sure”表示核实、确认，能说明重复提问是为避免理解出错。
